title: X-posing Free Speech: Examining the Impact of Moderation Relaxation on Online Social Networks
findings: The study found a statistically significant 50.2% increase in the composition of hateful content targeting religion following the relaxation of moderation. The discourse also intensified, using more extreme and negative terms like 'murderous' and 'evil' to portray religious concepts.
